sentences.text:
Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.5386 Of 2020
Order:

-
This petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, seeking return of the property that was seized in Crime No.207 of 2020 by Station House Officer of Tenali I Town Police Station.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
3. The petitioner is the sole accused in Crime No. 207 of 2020 of Tenali I Town Police Station.

A case under Sections 188, 420, 272, 273 IPC, Sections 56, 57(1) and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and under Sections 7(1), 20(1) and 22 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 (for short "COTP Act") was registered against him.

entities.text: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. On a petition filed by the petitioner for quash of the said F.I.R in Criminal Petition No.4665 of 2020, this Court has quashed the said F.I.R registered against him as per order dated 21.10.2020.
Therefore, as the F.I.R that was registered against him is now quashed, he is entitled to custody of the property that was seized from his possession in connection with the above crime.
5. In the result, the Criminal Petition is allowed.

The Station House Officer of Tenali I Town Police Station is hereby directed to give custody of the tobacco products along with cash of Rs.1,72,400/-
that were seized from the possession of the petitioner in connection with the above crime, to the petitioner on proper acknowledgment and identification.
Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending, in this Criminal Petition, shall stand closed.
____________________________________________

JUSTICE CHEEKATI MANAVENDRANATH ROY Date: 25-11-2020 AKN THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE CHEEKATI MANAVENDRANATH ROY CRIMINAL PETITION No.5386 OF 2020 Date: 25-11-2020 AKN Kowthavarapu Nammaiah vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 25 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43427579/
